# no-homogeneous-tags

Disallow a tag on every one of two or more Scenarios or Examples blocks where it belongs on the parent.

| Category | Recommended | Safe autofix | Default options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| tags | no | no | none |

Finds each tag present on every one of two or more Scenarios of a Feature or Rule, or of two or more Examples blocks.

## Configuration

```json
{ "rules": { "no-homogeneous-tags": "error" } }
```

## Triggered by

```text
@smoke on every Scenario
```
